\[
C=\{(x,y,z):x,y,z>0,\ x+y\le r,\ x+z\le s,\ y+z\le t\}.

If there is no full-support boundary, then \(C\subseteq D\). If the full-support boundary is \(g=(A,B,C_0)\), then

\]

\((X_0,Y_0)=(0,a_2)\), \((X_{r+1},Y_{r+1})=(a_1,0)\)

\]

**Lemma A.8 (weighted Ferrers and rank-cut bounds).** For the full-support boundary \((A,B,C_0)\), define
\[
W(r;A,B)=\sum_{i=A}^{r\mathbin{\dot-}B}
\min\{A(r-i),Bi\},
\]
where an interval with lower endpoint above its upper endpoint is empty. Define
\[
\Phi(r;A,B)=\min_{0\le l\le r}
\big((r-l)[A-l]_++l[B+l-r]_+
+[A-l]_+[B+l-r]_+\big).
\]
Let \(Q(r;A,B)\) be the number of positive pairs \(x\le A,y\le B\) with \(x+y>r\), and put \(F(r;A,B)=\max\{1,Q(r;A,B),W(r;A,B),\Phi(r;A,B)\}\). Then
\[
|E_{12}|\ge F(r;A,B).
\]
The analogous inequalities hold for \(E_{13}\) and \(E_{23}\).

+\binom r2+\binom s2+\binom t2

\]

**Lemma A.21 (surplus forced by origin-free families).** Assume \(r\ge s\ge t\).
If \(r=s=R\) and \(t\ge2\), the combined axis and plane extras contribute at least two beyond the baseline axis lengths \((R,R,R)\).

\[
